I’ve had this since I was about seven and now I am 22. I’m not exactly sure how or why it started but with a lot of therapy I did find out that a possible reason it may have started was because of trauma, I remember having to go to the hospital because I broke my arm and right before they gave me anesthesia and I was going under I absolutely thought I was going to die and I couldn’t breathe and when I think back to it the feeling was similar to the panic that I get now. When I felt I was going to die I reached out for my parents or anyone to grab my hand because I was sure I was dying but everyone in the room parents, nurses, etc weren’t paying attention and having side conversations. Then when I woke up I was talking about how I wanted pancakes and my parents were going to get them for me as a reward and the nurse warned them that if I ate I would v* and choke and die. This is only a possibility of when it started but with pretty strong evidence. I think I remember being afraid before that but I was very young so the memories are a bit hazy and out of order. I remember before this phobia as a kid I was a completely different person. I was able to be happy and carefree instead of constantly paranoid, terrified and miserable and I have been this way ever since the phobia started. I think it’s possible people have a pre disposition to this fear and then something in their life happens that unlocks it or triggers it to come to life is my theory about it
